Title: Now available: Azure Media Services v3 API

Body.Content:
Now available, the new Azure Media Services API helps you build media applications that include encoding, content protection with digital rights management (DRM), video indexing, live streaming, dynamic packaging, and content delivery at scale. Azure Media Services API features a simplified development and management model, a new live streaming entity, and Azure Media Player updates.

Learn more
